title: Addressing the Translation adjudicator
description: How to write for a reader acting as Translation adjudicator. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `translation-adjudicator` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Comparative
rules.description: Comparative. Present the alternatives side by side with what each preserves and loses. Do not pre-select.

source.quote: Decides between competing translations, usually a subject expert in the target language. Arrives at a disagreement and needs both options and the reason each was offered.
